categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing industry, focusing on high-end PCB products for enterprise communications, automotive electronics, industrial equipment, semiconductor chip testing, and consumer electronics. Key segments include enterprise communications market boards, automotive boards, industrial equipment boards, and consumer electronics boards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, multi-layer boards (especially 18 layers and above), embedded power chip packaging integration (P2Pack), laser drilling with high precision, and materials innovation such as embedded high-voltage chip substrates. It emphasizes automation, intelligent manufacturing, and continuous process improvements to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are in the enterprise communications sector (including AI servers, high-performance computing, and high-speed network equipment), automotive electronics (electric vehicles, advanced driver-assistance systems), industrial control, semiconductor testing, and consumer electronics. The company serves global OEMs and tier-1 suppliers in these industries, maintaining long-term strategic partnerships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Kunshan, Huangshi, and Changzhou, and has expanded overseas with a production facility in Thailand and subsidiaries in Singapore and Hong Kong. Its sales cover domestic and international markets, with significant export sales primarily to the Asia-Pacific region, Americas, Europe, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of PCBs and related assembly products. It also engages in upstream R&D and downstream sales and after-sales services, positioning itself as a key component supplier within the global electronics manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on high-end PCB products for AI, high-speed networking, and automotive electronics, with continuous investment in R&D to develop next-generation HDI, multi-layer, and embedded chip technologies. The company emphasizes agile product development, supply chain resilience, green manufacturing, and digital transformation including automation and AI-driven process optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of various PCB types and related electronic components. Additional income streams include sales of scrap materials, property sales, and rental income. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading brand in the PCB industry in China and globally, recognized among the top 100 PCB enterprises. It competes with other major PCB manufacturers in China, Taiwan, Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia, leveraging its technological innovation, product quality, and diversified customer base to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 13.34 billion, a 49.26% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 2.59 billion, up 71.05%. The company has shown strong growth momentum, expanding production capacity and improving profitability with a net asset base of RMB 11.84 billion and total assets of RMB 21.18 billion at year-end.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced technology leadership in high-density, high-layer count PCBs, and embedded chip integration, delivering high-quality, reliable products tailored for cutting-edge applications in AI, automotive, and communications. It emphasizes rapid customer response, flexible production capabilities, cost control, and sustainable green manufacturing practices to provide superior value to customers.
